differences.a_observable: The background elements in the upper right corner are out of focus.
differences.b_observable: The background elements in the upper right corner are sharp and in focus.
differences.fix: Enable camera depth of field and adjust the aperture to blur background elements.

differences.a_observable: The shadow cast by the yellow Recurly button is soft and diffused.
differences.b_observable: The shadow cast by the yellow Recurly button is sharp and dark.
differences.fix: Increase the light source size or shadow samples to soften contact shadows.

differences.a_observable: A strong vignette is visible, darkening the corners of the frame.
differences.b_observable: The vignette is absent, leaving the corners bright.
differences.fix: Add a vignette effect in post-production to match the reference.

json.highest_impact_fix: Enable camera depth of field to match the soft focus on background elements, and soften the contact shadows under the buttons.
